title: Broken Promises
summary: Drink to gain +2 Strength until Long Rest, then suffer an indefinite −1 Strength penalty. Removing the original effect early can also trigger the penalty.

fields.Effect: Drink to gain +2 Strength until Long Rest, then suffer an indefinite −1 Strength penalty. Removing the original effect early can also trigger the penalty.
